species.look_here_first: LOOK HERE FIRST: Is this a rhizomatous upright herb, rather than a large woody sagebrush shrub? Check the soft silvery or two-toned stem leaves (entire, toothed or lobed), then the many small, inconspicuous flower heads in a narrow to branched cluster. Leaf color alone cannot confirm the species.

note: Contact sheets screen broad visible content; exact anatomical features and species determination require full-resolution and expert confirmation.
